summary: Milestone 23 iter100 retest — PUT /api/items partial-update fix VERIFIED. All 44 unit pytests green (41 regression + 3 iter99 learning-loop). 3 new live iter100 tests green (PUT name-only preserves variants, learned-autocomplete composes 'Canon — Variant' label even after rename, archived-canonical /link returns 400 'canonical_item_archived'). Frontend E2E on /expenses/raw-materials → view-purchase → InvoiceReviewDialog → edit-item-btn → SmartItemAutocomplete: input surfaces 12 suggestions with data-source=canonical|alias attributes, pick+save successfully links (toast 'Linked to catalog: CHICKEN', display-name-0 updated). Vendor detail: invoice-item-row-{idx} elements present with data-canonical-id attr (empty on unlinked rows — code correctly gates cursor-pointer on nav flag).

integration_issues.issue: linked-badge-{i} is hidden when canonical_name === raw_name (by design in InvoiceReviewDialog.js L419: `it.canonical_name && it.canonical_name !== (it.raw_name||'')`). When user selects an autocomplete option whose label already matches the raw_name string, the link succeeds but the teal 'Canon' badge never shows — only the variant-badge would surface a visual. Consider always showing linked-badge when canonical_item_id is set, or at minimum when source was a learned/canonical pick, so users get consistent linked feedback regardless of raw/canonical string equality.

issues: DialogContent console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby — accessibility lint only, not blocking

action_items: (MEDIUM) InvoiceReviewDialog linked-badge gating: relax `canonical_name !== raw_name` guard so users see the Linked badge whenever canonical_item_id is truthy — the current guard hides the badge after a normal Save, reducing visibility of successful catalog linkage.
(LOW) Add aria-describedby / <DialogDescription> to InvoiceReviewDialog and Purchase Details DialogContent to silence Radix a11y warnings.
(LOW/nice-to-have) Expose an archive-approved-item route (PATCH /api/items/{id}/archive) so the archived-canonical guard is exercisable via public API; currently requires direct DB flip.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/items.py update_item() is now correctly using model_dump(exclude_unset=True) + dropping None values + normalising variants. Fix landed and verified by live test (PUT {name:X} leaves variants intact).
routes/invoice_items.py /link correctly raises HTTP 400 'canonical_item_archived' when target.is_archived is True (line 146-147). Verified via DB-flip live test.

core/models.CanonicalItemCreate does NOT declare is_archived/is_suggested — which is fine for CREATE but means PUT also cannot flip those via API. If product wants UI-driven archive of approved canonicals, extend the model or add a dedicated endpoint.
SmartItemAutocomplete component exposes data-testid={testId}-input, -panel, -option-{i} with data-source attribute — good testability. Confirmed in live E2E.

success_rate.frontend_e2e: 100% on critical flow (login → Raw Materials → InvoiceReviewDialog → SmartItemAutocomplete pick → Save → display-name update)

seed_data_creation: 3 TEST_-prefixed canonical items created and torn down (DELETE) per test fixture. One 'CHICKEN' canonical link was saved against a SYSCO JACKSONVILLE purchase during FE E2E (Linked to catalog: CHICKEN toast); harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 1) Route for purchases list is /expenses/raw-materials, not /purchases. Use [data-testid^='view-purchase-'] (eye icon) to open InvoiceReviewDialog. 2) SmartItemAutocomplete inside InvoiceReviewDialog uses testId='edit-raw_name-{i}', so selectors are [data-testid='edit-raw_name-0-input'], [data-testid='edit-raw_name-0-panel'], [data-testid^='edit-raw_name-0-option-'] (each option exposes data-source). 3) For archived-canonical test, there is no public PUT path to flip is_archived on an approved item (CanonicalItemCreate doesn't declare the field); the live test flips directly in MongoDB using MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from /app/backend/.env. 4) linked-badge-{i} only renders when canonical_name !== raw_name — not a bug per se, but surprising; logged as medium action item. 5) test_iter100_live.py is the canary for any future regressions on PUT /items semantics.
rca_of_the_issue: Original iter99 bug (PUT wipes variants/status) is resolved. Root-cause fix: routes/items.py update_item() switched from data.model_dump() (which hydrates all declared Optional fields to None) to data.model_dump(exclude_unset=True) + filtering None + normalising variants only when provided → $set with the minimal diff. Verified with three live tests covering (a) variants preservation on name-only PUT, (b) learned-autocomplete still composes 'Canonical — Variant' label after rename, (c) /link returns 400 canonical_item_archived when canonical is archived (flipped via direct DB write due to model not exposing is_archived).
